post_caption:
Every Sunday panic starts on Friday. 😅

Friday: "It's due Monday, plenty of time."
Saturday: brunch, a shift, laundry, friends.
Sunday, 9 PM: you open the brief. 2,000 words, 4 sources.

The fix takes 10 minutes on Friday afternoon: look at your next 14 days, spot what's due Monday, and book two short slots before the weekend starts.

Save this for next Friday. What's due on your Monday? 👇
